title: Privacy Policy
content:
# Happy Farmer · Privacy Policy

Last updated: October 2026

## 1. Overview

Happy Farmer is developed by **LelelelingStudio**. We take your privacy seriously.

**In one sentence: no sign-up, no login, no personal identity data. Your progress is stored in your own browser by default.**

## 2. Data stored on your device

The following is kept in browser localStorage and is **never automatically uploaded**:

- Game progress (gold, level, EXP, days, farm, storage, factory, quests, achievements)
- Your nickname and avatar
- Preferences (language, volume, display)
- Save-export history

You can clear it anytime from Settings or your browser's site-data settings.

## 3. Leaderboard — the only online feature

If you **opt in** to the leaderboard (unlocked at level 5), the following is uploaded to our leaderboard server:

| Uploaded | Notes |
|---|---|
| Random player ID | A random string like `user_xxx`, unrelated to your identity |
| Nickname | The nickname you set (can be hidden) |
| Avatar marker | **Only built-in emoji or avatar-library numbers** |
| Game values | Level, gold, days, total EXP, achievements, fortune, collection, factory |
| Submit time | Used to sanity-check submissions |

### 3.1 What we never collect

- ❌ Real name, phone, email, address — any identity data
- ❌ Passwords (there is no account system)
- ❌ Your full save file
- ❌ **Custom uploaded avatar images** (stored locally as base64; the leaderboard forces them hidden and never uploads them)

### 3.2 Public nickname and avatar

- **Public**: your nickname and avatar appear on the leaderboard
- **Anonymous**: hide nickname, hide avatar, or both
- Hidden entries show "匿名玩家" and a blank avatar
- **Custom uploaded avatars are always hidden**

You can change this anytime; it takes effect immediately.

## 4. How leaderboard data is used

- Up to **100,000** players are stored
- Used **solely to display the leaderboard**
- Automatic rules sanity-check submissions (no decreasing values, no impossible growth) to limit cheating
- Clearly invalid data may be flagged for review or removed

## 5. Browser notifications

If you enable the next-day reminder, the game asks for notification permission. You control this entirely in your browser and can revoke it anytime. Notifications only contain in-game reminders.

## 6. Third parties

- **Leaderboard server**: Cloudflare Workers with Cloudflare D1 storage (see Cloudflare's privacy policy)
- **Static hosting**: Surge
- No ad SDKs, no analytics SDKs, no social login

## 7. Audio

Music and sound effects are bundled locally and played on-device; nothing is uploaded.

## 8. Children

No chat, no user-generated content, no payments — suitable for all ages. We collect no identity data from anyone, including children.

## 9. Deleting data

To delete leaderboard data:

1. Switch visibility to **Anonymous** in game (hides nickname and avatar immediately)
2. Or contact us with your player ID (shown in the User Center) and we will remove the record

To delete local data: clear your browser site data, or reset the game in Settings.

## 10. Changes

This policy may be updated as features change; the date at the top will be revised. Continued use means you accept the updated policy.

## 11. Contact

For privacy questions, reach us through the game's published contact channels.

**Produced by LelelelingStudio · Lelelegame**
